notes.title: Patch Notes – "Less Bugs, More Bosses, and Hopefully No New Problems" Edition
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the Player could step into Lava – You are now slightly less flammable.

Fixed an issue with the kill count of the broken Windstone not going down when backtracking to higher floors 

Fixed an issue with the Phoenix achievement not activating properly – Rising from the ashes should now work as advertised.

Nerfed the rat's evasion – The rats have been downgraded from "untouchable ninjas" to "mildly annoying rodents."

Added a requirement to build the Resting Place before entering the dungeon to reduce Player frustration – No bed, no dungeon. You’re welcome.

Fixed recipe for Stirred-Up Stew not showing all ingredients – You’ll now know exactly what you’re eating. Whether that’s a good thing is debatable.

Added an optional Super Boss – For players who thought the game was getting too easy. Have fun suffering.

Added an achievement for said Super Boss – If you actually beat it, you deserve a trophy (and maybe a therapist).

Removed the "You don't have enough materials" messages. They were just slowing things down.

Re-added upfront loading – The game should now load properly again. If anything explodes, glitches, or summons an eldritch horror, let me know!
